_about: Corrections to the Board's published index and to corpus rows, each checked by hand against the decision's own text. Read by errata.py; applied by audit_completeness.py (index) and repair_corpus.py (corpus). Add an entry only with evidence: what the Board's page says, and what the decision itself says.

index.evidence: The 2024 ALJ index links TB8312 (CTP v. DIY Vapor Supply) and CR6510 (Complete Care at Arbors v. CMS) to each other's pages. The alj-tb8312 page opens 'DIY Vapor Supply LLC d/b/a DIY Vapor Supply, DAB TB8312 (2024)'; alj-cr6510 opens 'Complete Care at Arbors, CR6510 (2024)'.
The other half of the TB8312/CR6510 swap above.

The 2025 ALJ index lists two decisions as TB8762. The second, 'CTP v. Sonia and Ami, Inc. d/b/a Charlie's Food Mart' (2025-02-05), links to alj-tb9064, and the decision opens 'Sonia and Ami, Inc. d/b/a Charlie's Food Mart, DAB TB9064 (2025)'.

The index lists two decisions as DAB942: Washington State Department of Social and Health Services (1987-12-11, linked to dab924.html) and Florida Department of Health and Rehabilitative Services (1988-03-23, dab942.html). The 1987 decision opens 'Washington State Department of Social and Health Services, DAB No. 924 (1987)'.

The 2020 ALJ index captions 'Cardiac Imaging Associates A Medical Corporation v. CMS' (2020-02-03) as CR5224 but links it to alj-cr5524; CR5224 is Beacon Ambulance Service, Inc. v. CMS (2018-12-12). Checked live 2026-11-01: the alj-cr5524 page opens 'Cardiac Imaging Associates A Medical Corporation, DAB CR5524 (2020)' and reads 'Decision No. CR5524 February 3, 2020'.

The 1987 index captions 'National Health Plan, Inc.' (1987-05-27) as DAB171 but links it to dab871.html; DAB 171 is Montana Department of Social and Rehabilitation Services (1981). Checked 2026-11-01 (Internet Archive copy of dab871.html): 'National Health Plan, Inc., DAB No. 871 (1987) ... Decision No. 871 DATE: May 27, 1987'.

Listed in both the 2013 and the 2014 ALJ index with the identical caption '2014.03.28 BOARD DISMISSAL, 2013.12.12 CR3031 Peter Victor Ayika v. The Inspector General'. Checked 2026-11-01: the two PDFs (2013/cr3031.pdf, 2014/cr3031.pdf, Internet Archive copies) are byte-identical (SHA-1 4df080bc...). The corpus holds CR3031 from the 2013 listing.

The 1993 index lists DAB1416 and DAB1417 with the identical caption 'Anthony Accaputo, Jr. vs. The Inspector General' (1993-06-03). Checked live 2026-11-01: hhs.gov's dab1417 page serves DAB 1416 word for word ('Decision No. 1416', Docket No. C-92-001). The Board has not published a DAB 1417 at that address; there is nothing to fetch under it.

Brenham Healthcare Center v. CMS, Ruling No. 2027-1 (Oct. 13, 2026) was first listed in the 2026 Board decisions as RUL2027-1 at board-decisions/2026/board-ruling-2027-1. By 2026-11-02 the Board had moved it to the 2026 ALJ decisions as 'ALJ Ruling No. 2027-1' at alj-decisions/2026/alj-ruling-2027-1, and the old Board URL returns Page Not Found. The ALJ page reads 'Civil Remedies Division ... Docket No. C-26-16, Ruling No. 2027-1, October 13, 2026, ORDER OF DISMISSAL', and the corpus row's own tribunal field already says Civil Remedies Division. The ALJ copy is fetched into alj by the daily update.
